stories.title: O primeiro dia no Rio
stories.text:
Ali chega ao Rio de manhã.
Ele pega um táxi até o ___ (1).
No quarto ele bebe um ___ (2).
Depois liga para a ___ (3).
stories.en: Ali reaches Rio in the morning. He takes a taxi to the hotel. In the room he drinks a coffee. Then he calls his family.

stories.title: No mercado
stories.text:
Sara vai ao ___ (1) no domingo.
Compra pão, leite e ___ (2).
Ela paga com o ___ (3).
stories.en: Sara goes to the market on Sunday. She buys bread, milk and apples. She pays by card.

stories.title: O passaporte perdido
stories.text:
Ahmad procura o seu ___ (1).
Ele pede ajuda a um ___ (2).
Por sorte encontra na ___ (3).
stories.en: Ahmad is looking for his passport. He asks a policeman for help. Luckily he finds it in his bag.

stories.title: No médico
stories.text:
Bilal não está ___ (1).
Ele vai ao ___ (2).
O médico dá remédio e ___ (3).
stories.en: Bilal is unwell. He goes to the doctor. The doctor gives medicine and rest.

stories.title: A aula de português
stories.text:
Nadia aprende ___ (1) há três meses.
Ela pratica toda noite com ___ (2).
O ___ (3) dela diz que ela já fala bem.
stories.en: Nadia has been learning Portuguese for three months. She practises every evening with books. Her teacher says she already speaks well.

stories.title: Almoço em família
stories.text:
No domingo chega toda a ___ (1).
A avó cozinha ___ (2).
Todos comem juntos e ___ (3) muito.
stories.en: On Sunday the whole family comes. The grandmother cooks rice. Everyone eats together and laughs a lot.

stories.title: Na estação
stories.text:
O trem está dez minutos ___ (1).
Hassan compra um ___ (2) na banca.
Depois entra no ___ (3).
stories.en: The train is ten minutes late. Hassan buys a newspaper. Then he gets on the train.

stories.title: Uma noite de inverno
stories.text:
Em julho faz muito ___ (1).
Aisha veste um ___ (2) quente.
Ela bebe um ___ (3) quente e lê.
stories.en: In July it is very cold. Aisha wears a warm coat. She drinks hot tea and reads.

stories.title: Jantar no hotel
stories.text:
O garçom traz o ___ (1).
Omar pede peixe e ___ (2).
No fim ele pede a ___ (3).
stories.en: The waiter brings the menu. Omar orders fish and rice. At the end he asks for the bill.

stories.title: Novos amigos
stories.text:
Lena e Sana se encontram no ___ (1).
Elas falam de música e de ___ (2).
No fim trocam os ___ (3).
stories.en: Lena and Sana meet in the park. They talk about music and travel. At the end they exchange their numbers.
